My game was one of the winners in Claude for Games Build Day in SF 🛸

Moo Over SF: scan a QR and your phone becomes a UFO controller. 60 seconds to beam up more cows than your friends.

Built with Claude Code and @apify.

What else in SF should ruin a round?

@claudeai #gamedev https://t.co/SIwEoqSG2N
correct the work it did 😅 although in fair honesty, its getting too good. esp Opus 5.5, it just one shot things

Play it here: https://t.co/UbkADw7wdU

One big screen, up to 8 players, no app.

Thanks @soyrichlira @petroshong @CathyChang00 and Coco Wang for hosting, and the Claude Community team for running it. 

It was a really fun experience. 

PS: Built entirely with #ClaudeCode
